responsibility: This header defines the `cortexa73_tunings` model for Arm Cortex-A73 in the AArch64 backend. It packages Cortex-A57-derived cost components with Cortex-A73-specific issue-rate and fusion settings, plus the usual alignment, reassociation, prefetch, and load/store-pair policies, so GCC can apply code-generation heuristics tailored to Cortex-A73 rather than the earlier A57/A72 profiles.
